title: Every container has an address
summary: Find a container's IP address and its network's gateway, then visit it by number from another container.

tasks.title: `ip.txt` holds the IP address of `target`
tasks.hint: `docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' target` prints it. Copy it into `ip.txt` and save.

tasks.title: `gateway.txt` holds the gateway of the default network
tasks.hint: The default network is called `bridge`: `docker network inspect bridge` and look for `Gateway`.

tasks.title: `page.txt` holds the title of `target`'s page, fetched by number
tasks.hint: From another container on the same network: `docker run --rm busybox wget -qO- http://<ip>`. The title is the text between `<title>` and `</title>`.
